ctx.x: Who were some of the blues piano players that you worked with, like Clarence Johnson?

Fat Waller, Fat Waller, Willie Smith, the Lion, oh, like I told you, Leroy Smith, I can't think of what his name, Brooks, Brooks, Porter Granger, Jelly Roll Martin, Clarence Johnson, Donald Haywood, Donald Haywood, Russell Robison, Clarence Williams, Clarence Williams, Glover Compton, Hutchinson, but I don't think he's in this country because I think he's a West Indian, he went, when he went abroad, he couldn't come back. I don't think he's in this country, but he's a piano player out the book. Hutchinson and Sam…
Who was your favorite piano player to back you up, who'd you like to work with?
